text: Because a semiconductor laser biased near threshold has a fast photon field and a slow carrier population, its two-timescale excitable dynamics map naturally onto the ___-Nagumo model of an excitable neuron.
explanation: The FitzHugh-Nagumo system (a fast voltage-like activator plus a slow recovery inhibitor) captures the geometry of excitability and matches the fast-photon/slow-carrier dynamics of a near-threshold laser, which is why excitable lasers behave like FitzHugh-Nagumo/LIF neurons.
